run_scorecard_benchmark: run the script to generate a scorecard SVG from perf.csv benchmark data
create_pivot_table: create a pivot table from a CSV with time values indexed by operator, shape, and fuser
compute_speedups: compute speedup ratios by dividing each fuser's time by the eager baseline time
plot_bar_chart: plot a bar chart of speedups per operator with configurable figure size and axis limits
save_svg_figure: save the generated matplotlib figure as an SVG file for benchmark scorecard reporting
